title: The Zenith of the Abyss

features.name: the highest depth
features.desc-on-touch: You stand at the point where asking goes so deep it emerges at the sky. The questions rest here before they rise.

features.name: the inverse ladder
features.desc-on-touch: Rungs made of light, descending upward. Hold them and you rise by falling.

features.name: the stillness at the turning
features.desc-on-touch: A moment where questions pause before they invert. It is not silence; it is the sound of direction changing.

inscription: at the zenith of questions that fall upward, the abyss learns to look down and sees itself reflected in sky

file.name: Inversion_Diagram_Untitled_Handscrawl.png
file.note: A drawing of stairs. You cannot determine if they descend or ascend. Every time you look, they change.
